alarm.name: Break alarms
alarm.description: Rings at the end of a focus session to get you up.

break.title: Time for a break
break.body: Stand up and move for a few minutes.
break.bodySnoozed: Break snoozed {count} times. Get up now.
break.largeBody: Stand up, stretch, walk around. Two minutes are enough to get your focus back.
break.largeBodyWithFocus: {minutes} minutes of focus, done. Stand up, stretch and walk a little before the next one.

habit.body: Time to check off this habit.
